 Paya Rumput rep’s 4 aspirations focus on flood mitigation, local economy, housing, youth opportunities
 By 
 FocusM 
 37 seconds ago 
 in 
 Politics , Top 
 FOUR priorities outlined in the Aspirasi Paya Rumput initiative by Datuk Azman Abidin a.k.a. Tok Man focus on issues affecting residents’ everyday lives, including infrastructure and road safety, local economic development, housing and community well-being as well as education and career opportunities for young people.
 Anchored in the broader Aspirasi Melaka Rumah Kita framework, the approach seeks to translate the state’s development agenda into constituency-level priorities with an emphasis on coordination, cooperation with relevant agencies and consistent follow-up.
 The first priority by the Pakatan Harapan (PH) candidate addresses flooding, traffic congestion and road safety in Paya Rumput.
 The proposed efforts include identifying frequently affected locations, coordinating follow-up with relevant agencies and assessing infrastructure improvement needs.
 Road safety – particularly around schools and routes commonly used by residents – is also a key consideration. The approach places emphasis on understanding issues on the ground and ensuring that concerns raised by the community receive appropriate attention and follow-up.
 Editor’s Note: Azman who has served as the political secretary to Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim since December 2022 is engaged in a three-corner fight in today’s (Nov 14) Melaka state election against Perikatan Nasional’s (PN) Rafie Ahmad from PAS and BERSAMA’s Abdul Rashid Abu Bakar . 
 The state constituency was previously held by UMNO’s Rais Yasin who is not defending the seat this time around. 
 Stronger wider economic opportunities 
 The second aspiration focuses on strengthening the local economy by supporting small traders and local entrepreneurs.
 Areas of focus include access to business facilities, financing information, training, marketing and digitalisation support. Coordination involving business premises and licensing is also part of the effort to help local traders access relevant information and appropriate support channels.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by Azman Abidin (@azmanabidinofficial) 
 The aim is to strengthen the capacity of local businesses and create greater opportunities for economic activity within the community.
 Housing and neighbourhood well-being form the third priority. This aspiration covers neighbourhood cleanliness, the maintenance of local facilities and home repair needs among eligible households.
 Residents’ concerns and needs will be channelled and followed up with the relevant authorities and agencies, taking into account eligibility criteria, priorities and available allocations.
 The emphasis is on identifying local needs and addressing them through the appropriate channels.
 Skilled youth, a more secure future 
 The fourth aspiration focuses on youth development through education, technical and vocational education and training (TVET), industry skills and employment opportunities.
 The proposed efforts include improving access to information on education assistance, career guidance and connections with training institutions and industry players. The objective is to help young people in Paya Rumput better prepare for employment and build their future.
 PH Paya Rumput candidate Datuk Datuk Azman Abidin a.k.a. Tok Man accompanying Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim to visit the Krubong Jaya Business Centre as part of the latter’s campaign spree for the Melaka state polls 
 The four aspirations are intended to be pursued through cooperation with the Melaka state government, the Federal Government, local authorities and relevant agencies in accordance with their respective mandates and established processes.
 The implementation approach also emphasises identifying local issues and coordinating action, thus providing community updates and clearly reporting project status.
 The distinction between proposals, applications, approvals, implementation and completed projects will be maintained to ensure residents receive accurate information.
 Through these four priorities, Aspirasi Paya Rumput places its focus on strengthening the everyday lives of the local community in line with the vision of Makmur, Sejahtera, Terhubung and the broader aspiration of Melaka as a shared home for every Melaka folk. – Nov 14, 2026
